products.title: Lemon Tart Recipe
products.description: A small recipe booklet with ingredients, a preparation checklist and serving ideas.
products.content:
LEMON TART RECIPE

Ingredients: one ready-made tart shell, 3 eggs, 100 g sugar, 100 ml lemon juice, zest of one lemon and 100 ml cream.

Whisk the filling ingredients together, pour into the shell, and bake at 160 C until the center is just set. Let it cool before slicing. Check the tart as it bakes because ovens and shell sizes vary.

Preparation checklist: read the shell instructions, wash the lemon, measure ingredients, preheat the oven and set out a cooling rack. Serve with berries or a little whipped cream.

products.title: Evening Photo Walk Guide
products.description: A pocket checklist for planning an evening photo walk and comparing compositions.
products.content:
EVENING PHOTO WALK

Choose a familiar route and check when it gets dark. Bring a charged camera or phone and a small support if you use one.

At each stop, make three versions: a wide view, a close detail, and a frame with a person or object providing scale. Compare horizontal and vertical compositions. Notice reflections and changes in light.

Before leaving, check sharpness and exposure. Afterward, pick three favorites and write a sentence about why each works. Share the photos you like with a friend.
